exceptions.reason: Contract behavior change already merged before policy integration: the replacement reservation guard requires person-confirmed quota_pool_fingerprint instead of self-reported quota_fingerprint. Existing accounts start unconfirmed, so new/reactivated shared-pool holds stop until a person confirms; existing active holds may still release/settle. This is not expand-safe and previous-binary read probes do not prove quota-write compatibility. AEON-415 draft PR #71 exposes this exact-byte exception for coordinator review; owner acceptance of the rollout or a staged follow-up migration is required before release.

Expand-only family widening: replace the existing harness check with its strict superset (media and terminal). No existing value, row, column, or route is removed; nullable execution labels preserve previous-binary writes. The classifier conservatively flags DROP CONSTRAINT. This exact-byte exception is exposed in the draft PR for coordinator review, with previous-binary migration compatibility exercised in CI.

Expand-only event visibility widening for two exact ticket-snapshot types: status_autopilot.changed and status_autopilot.skipped. All tenant, visible-node, referenced-node, own-event and workspace-only domain checks remain intact. ALTER POLICY is conservatively outside the classifier allowlist. This exact-byte exception is exposed in draft PR #122 for coordinator review; database regressions exercise actual publication and project-only reads while denying cross-project references, run telemetry and unknown autopilot types. Previous-binary migration compatibility runs in CI.

Only definition-selected drops of historical enum CHECKs need this one-file exception. Superset replacements are ADD CONSTRAINT CHECK NOT VALID followed by VALIDATE CONSTRAINT, both allowlisted. Every historical harness/family/adapter value, pi unknown-family policy and the review null-pairing predicate remain intact. No rows, columns, RLS policies or other constraints are removed. This exact-byte draft CI exception still requires coordinator acceptance before merge/release and previous-binary compatibility measurement; it grants no release authority.

The only non-allowlisted statement drops aithema_journal_records_original_bytes_check after a bounded replacement CHECK is installed NOT VALID. All other expansion statements in 1100 are allowlisted. Validation is isolated in 1101 after the exclusive lock is released; 1102 creates the unique content-address index concurrently. Logical content/snapshot documents are capped at 16 MiB and ordinary events at 1 MiB. This exact-byte exception requires coordinator review before merge/release; it does not grant acceptance or skip previous-binary compatibility probes.

Additive work-kind tables and tenant seed with an area-schema widening from the six existing strings to their slug-pattern superset. The classifier conservatively flags the tenant-loop DO backfill and CREATE OR REPLACE of the schema helper. Existing values, rows, and binary writes remain valid; Go area gates remain unchanged until 502c. Exact bytes are exposed in this draft PR for coordinator review; migration compatibility is measured in CI before any merge/release.

Digest-mode widening to the strict superset r4-v1, document-v1 and document-v2. The replacement CHECK removes no historical value; replacement issuance/confirmation functions preserve existing predicates while admitting the canonical v2 document mode. No issued digest, snapshot, link or acceptance evidence is rewritten. DROP CONSTRAINT is conservatively outside the classifier allowlist. This exact-byte declaration requires coordinator review before merge/release and does not waive previous-binary compatibility probes. The previous binary cannot interpret newly issued v2 documents, so app rollback after new v2 issuance must be gated; roll forward or disable quote writes and use a v2-capable binary.

Issue event linkage moves to deferred FK and constraint-trigger validation at commit; quote completeness, draft state, totals and immutable evidence remain guarded. This permits imports to insert issues and update quote state before the event counter, with predicted event identities checked during final flush. No rows, tables, columns, digests or evidence are rewritten. ALTER CONSTRAINT and replacement trigger-function definitions require this exact-byte exception; coordinator review and previous-binary compatibility CI remain required before merge/release.
